title: Art. 6.1.4 — Annex 9 - Facilitation, Chapter 6 - International Airports - Facilities and Services for Traffic, A. General, 6.1.4
content:
Each Contracting State, in consultation with airport operators, shall ensure that facilities and services provided at international airports are, where possible, flexible and capable of expansion to meet traffic growth, an increase in security requirements arising from increased threat, or other changes to support border integrity measures.

Note. With respect to aviation security requirements, attention is drawn to the relevant specification in Annex 17, Chapter 2, 2.3.
